items.title: DBS, Maybank, IFC to collaborate on funding Johor-Singapore renewable energy project
items.snippet: The financing framework could be reference for future cross-border initiatives under Asean Power Grid

items.title: Singapore expects all parties to honour commitments, says PM Wong after Indonesia cuts gas exports
items.snippet: The Republic needs ‘cleaner sources of power that can provide reliable electricity around the clock’, he adds

items.title: Indonesia reduces gas exports to Singapore in order to 'safeguard reliability' of domestic supplies
items.snippet: Indonesia's diversion of exports to meet domestic needs involves 31 million standard cubic feet of natural gas a day from Natuna and Sumatra, Indonesia’s upstream oil and gas regulator told CNA.

items.title: Indonesia begins cutting natural gas exports to Singapore from Oct 24: reports
items.snippet: The cut is equivalent to about 8% of the pipeline gas Indonesia exported to Singapore in 2024

items.title: Singapore launches S$143 million initiative to help industries cut emissions
items.snippet: Three companies have also been approved to import and supply biomethane, a renewable alternative to natural gas, as Singapore explores ways to help industries decarbonise.
